The fingertip clearly points inward toward the person, NOT outward. Entire standing person from head to plain slip-on shoes, large enough to read the gesture. No symbols, speech bubbles or background props. A young woman in a plain teal blouse and beige trousers points to herself with her right index finger touching her sternum. Single square CACE vocabulary image. Pure white background, show every subject and essential prop whole inside the middle two thirds of the canvas. IMPORTANT: zoom the composition OUT. Leave roughly ONE SIXTH of canvas width on both the left and right and generous WHITE space above and below. No object or person's extremity touches an edge. No border. Absolutely no text, lettering, digits, writing or pseudo-writing, labels, watermarks, brand marks, logos or emblems anywhere. One clear composition.
